data.action: 拔刀出鞘立于布景光中
data.description: 【黑川茜 · 东京之刃】《东京之刃》舞台剧的决胜幕，黑川茜身着和风刺客戏服以纱姬之姿拔刀出鞘，蓝紫长发扬起，双瞳点亮为璀璨的星形——「这一刀，我要让整座剧场都记住纱姬的名字。」
data.promptProse: Akane performs the decisive Tokyo Blade scene as Sayahime, drawing her katana with concentrated star-lit eyes and blue-purple hair lifted by the turn. Her Japanese assassin stage costume stays clear in the cowboy view, with the blade crossing the near foreground and theater scenery layered behind. Blood-red stage light catches the sword and costume folds, creating a stronger bright edge against the darker backdrop and wings.
data.title: 黑川茜 · 东京之刃
